title: Rice/Paddy — Fertilizer and Nutrient Management
content:
FERTILIZER RECOMMENDATION FOR RICE (Karnataka):

FOR JYOTHI AND MEDIUM-DURATION VARIETIES (110-120 days):
Total N: 120 kg/ha (split in 3 doses)
Total P2O5: 50 kg/ha (all basal)
Total K2O: 50 kg/ha (half basal, half at panicle initiation)

SPLIT APPLICATION:
1. BASAL (at transplanting): N 40 kg/ha + P 50 kg/ha + K 25 kg/ha
2. TOP DRESS 1 (20-25 DAT, active tillering): N 40 kg/ha
3. TOP DRESS 2 (50-55 DAT, panicle initiation): N 40 kg/ha + K 25 kg/ha

HIGH YIELDING HYBRIDS (>6 t/ha target):
N: 150 kg/ha | P: 60 kg/ha | K: 60 kg/ha

ZINC DEFICIENCY:
- Very common in Karnataka paddy soils.
- ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha as basal application if zinc deficient.
- Foliar: ZnSO4 0.5% spray at 25 and 40 DAT if khaira disease appears (yellowing with brown patches).

SILICA:
- Silica amendments (slag/rice hull ash) improve blast tolerance.
- Apply @ 200 kg/ha if available.

FOLIAR NUTRITION:
- DAP 2% + KNO3 1% spray at boot leaf stage improves grain filling.
- Urea 1% spray if leaf yellowing observed (N deficiency check first).

ORGANIC MATTER:
- FYM 10 t/ha at land preparation improves soil health.
- Green manure (Sesbania) incorporation 15 days before transplanting reduces N requirement by 25 kg/ha.

KARNATAKA SOILS:
- Most paddy soils are lateritic/loamy — pH 5.5-6.5.
- Lime application (250 kg/ha) recommended if pH <5.5.
